name: COSTERS
summary: High-contrast luxury gourmet ecommerce built on an editorial bento grid that mixes moody product packshots, named product callouts with price, and lifestyle food photography.

typography.treatment: editorial, minimal, lots of negative space

sections.notes: Centered serif logo 'COSTERS' + minimal menu (Shop / About / Journal).
Editorial bento mixing caviar tins on dark panels + named product callouts + gourmet food photography.
Circular product seals as a premium trust motif.

interactions.pattern: hover reveal / lift on bento tiles

buildWithOnia: Add a bento-grid block that alternates product packshots with lifestyle photography tiles.
Add a product-callout tile: name + 'Starts at $X' + click-to-shop.
Use a circular seal/badge component as a trust motif.
High-contrast dark + cream palette via ONIA tokens; centered serif-logo nav for boutique brands.
